name: Dawn’s Embrace (Minor Artifact)
body:
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 20th; Weight 2.5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This +5 mithral buckler looks like smooth gold and is radiant like the sun. Upon missing the wielder of the Dawn’s Embrace with a melee attack, the attacker must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude saving throw or be blinded for 1 round. On a successful save, the attacker is dazzled instead.

DESTRUCTION

The Dawn’s Embrace is destroyed if dealt damage from a mythic source in the conditions of magical darkness on the Plane of Shadow.
